narrative.intro: Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C registered $2.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, across 7 awards with an average award size of $329M and obligations up 1171.7% year over year. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C received most of its FY2026 to date obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $2.2B, while the Department of Defense obligated $99M. Historical obligations show smaller annual totals before FY2026: FY21 $259M, FY22 $168M, FY23 $195M, FY24 $54.5M, and FY25 $181M. The FY2026 to date totals are partial and reflect the current fiscal year only. Buyers and contract totals are concentrated in a single agency for the current year, which explains the sharp year-over-year change. Award count and average award size indicate fewer, larger awards in FY2026 to date compared with prior years. The following sections answer who the largest buyers are and why FY2026 totals stand out, followed by short FAQ answers to common questions about contract value, buying agencies, contract contents, and expiring work.

sections.heading: Why are FY2026 to date obligations much larger than prior years?
sections.body: Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C obligations in FY2026 to date total $2.3B, which is larger than any previous fiscal year listed. Obligations rose up 1171.7% year over year, reflecting a concentration of awards in the current fiscal year. Historical annual obligations were $259M in FY21, $168M in FY22, $195M in FY23, $54.5M in FY24, and $181M in FY25.

sections.heading: Who are the top buying agencies for FY2026 to date?
